conversations_start_call_check.name: conversations_start_call_check
conversations_start_call_check.value: ("app"."conversations"."start_call_id" is not null) = ("app"."conversations"."parent_id" is not null)

conversations_root_check.name: conversations_root_check
conversations_root_check.value: ("app"."conversations"."title" is not null) = ("app"."conversations"."parent_id" is null) and ("app"."conversations"."updated_at" is not null) = ("app"."conversations"."parent_id" is null)

conversations_fork_check.name: conversations_fork_check
conversations_fork_check.value: "app"."conversations"."forked_from_id" is null or ("app"."conversations"."parent_id" is null and "app"."conversations"."forked_through_seq" is not null)

models_prices_check.name: models_prices_check
models_prices_check.value:
"app"."models"."input_usd_per_mtok" >= 0 and "app"."models"."output_usd_per_mtok" >= 0
        and "app"."models"."cache_write_usd_per_mtok" >= 0 and "app"."models"."cache_read_usd_per_mtok" >= 0
        and "app"."models"."long_context_input_usd_per_mtok" >= 0 and "app"."models"."long_context_output_usd_per_mtok" >= 0
        and "app"."models"."long_context_cache_write_usd_per_mtok" >= 0 and "app"."models"."long_context_cache_read_usd_per_mtok" >= 0

models_dimensions_check.name: models_dimensions_check
models_dimensions_check.value:
("app"."models"."purpose" = 'embedding'
          and "app"."models"."dimensions" is not null
          and "app"."models"."dimensions" between 1 and 4096
          and "app"."models"."long_context_above_input_tokens" is null)
        or ("app"."models"."purpose" = 'chat' and "app"."models"."dimensions" is null)

access_grants_target_check.name: access_grants_target_check
access_grants_target_check.value:
("app"."access_grants"."target_kind" = 'server'
          and "app"."access_grants"."server" is not null and "app"."access_grants"."tool" is null and "app"."access_grants"."model" is null)
        or ("app"."access_grants"."target_kind" = 'tool'
          and "app"."access_grants"."server" is not null and "app"."access_grants"."tool" is not null and "app"."access_grants"."model" is null)
        or ("app"."access_grants"."target_kind" = 'model'
          and "app"."access_grants"."server" is null and "app"."access_grants"."tool" is null and "app"."access_grants"."model" is not null)

agents_owner_name_idx.name: agents_owner_name_idx
agents_owner_name_idx.where: "app"."agents"."owner_id" is not null and "app"."agents"."deleted_at" is null

agents_builtin_key_check.name: agents_builtin_key_check
agents_builtin_key_check.value: "app"."agents"."builtin_key" is null or ("app"."agents"."owner_id" is null and "app"."agents"."builtin_key" in ('chat', 'agent', 'deep_agent', 'trainer'))

agents_closed_at_check.name: agents_closed_at_check
agents_closed_at_check.value: "app"."agents"."closed_at" is null or "app"."agents"."owner_id" is not null
